# REVV- Web — Full Technical & Product Context

## System Architecture
- **Web App**: Built with TanStack Start, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Nitro. Hosted on Vercel under the subdomain `revv.asteralabs.digital`.
- **Backend API**: High-performance Axum/Rust backend service providing endpoints for Authentication (`/api/v1/auth/*`), News Articles (`/api/v1/news`), Garage Management (`/api/v1/me/garage`), Social Feed (`/api/v1/feed/*`), and WebSocket telemetry (`/api/v1/ws`).
- **Mobile Companion**: Flutter application for iOS and Android with OpenStreetMap tile integration and live GPS tracking.

## Core Philosophies
1. **Safety & Clarity**: High-contrast, elderly-friendly legible interface ("RYDR bookend pattern") with cockpit identity and dark navigation aesthetics.
2. **Pack Solidarity**: Riding together with clear communication, route resumption, and emergency spotter awareness.
3. **Mechanical Pride**: Deep respect for machinery maintenance and service tracking in the Digital Garage.

## News Desks
- **MAINTENANCE**: Pre-ride checklists, fluid flushes, chain slack measurements, and preventative tire maintenance.
- **SAFETY & COMMS**: Group formation rules, Lead/Sweep protocols, Push-to-Talk intercom discipline, and hazard alerts.
- **RIDING CRAFT**: Cornering physics, wet-asphalt surface reading, throttle control, and emergency braking.
- **PRODUCT**: Announcements regarding REVV features, telemetry photo modes, and app updates.

## Access Policy
- Web registration is strictly disallowed.
- Login is open to authenticated riders using passwordless one-time passcodes (OTP) issued to their registered email or phone.
- New accounts must be created using the REVV mobile app.
